project.name: Alpine Dawn — AI Voice Hero Background
project.description: Photorealistic cinematic video background that reads as real camera footage from a luxury technology commercial: a genuine alpine lake at first light, thin fog drifting over mirror-calm water, layered mountains in natural haze, and a real-world premium studio microphone anchoring the foreground while an extremely subtle cyan-blue voice waveform breathes around it.

loop.strategy: Every animated parameter is periodic with a period dividing exactly into 10 s (temporal frequencies are integer multiples of 0.1 Hz); particles travel closed orbital paths; grain and all post effects cycle with the loop, so frame 600 is bit-identical to frame 0.
loop.perceived_repetition: phase offsets are spread so that no sub-interval of the loop visibly repeats or mirrors itself — the full 10 s period is the only exact repetition

authenticity.mandate: The result must be indistinguishable from footage captured on a professional cinema camera in a real location. The viewer should immediately believe this was filmed, not made.
authenticity.target_look: luxury technology commercial filmed in the Alps — flagship product-film cinematography crossed with high-end nature-documentary photography; a frame extracted from a $500,000 commercial
photographic_cues: true optical depth of field with distance-graded softness, never a uniform blur pass
natural sensor response: fine photochemical-style grain, soft highlight rolloff, no clipped whites
real-world surface imperfection everywhere: micro-scratches, dust, uneven rock, irregular treelines
asymmetric, irregular landscape forms — nothing procedurally repeated or mirrored
atmospheric depth built from genuine aerial perspective, not gradient overlays

scene.title: Alpine lake at first light
scene.location: Real high-altitude alpine valley; the camera stands at the edge of a perfectly calm mountain lake

composition.subject_anchor: center, slightly below the middle of the frame
composition.rule: The microphone is the visual anchor on the vertical centerline; the sun sits right of center (x ≈ 0.62); the landscape is naturally irregular, never symmetric.
composition.negative_space: Upper sky and lower lake surface stay visually quiet so interface content overlays legibly.

atmosphere.clarity: crisp mountain air with soft natural haze

atmospheric_perspective.model: physically based aerial perspective — each mountain layer loses contrast and saturation and lifts toward sky tone with distance, exactly as a long lens records it

fog.form: thin layer of morning fog moving slowly across the lake surface, with ragged natural edges
fog.behavior: very slow horizontal drift with gentle density breathing; sunlight passes through it, producing subtle volumetric light

airborne_particles.visibility: only where low sunlight catches them
airborne_particles.motion: closed micro-orbits at integer loop frequencies, drift under 2 cm/s

sky.condition: clear dawn sky with natural luminance falloff

clouds.type: high thin cirrus with irregular, wind-torn structure
clouds.motion: extremely slow sinusoidal drift (±0.4% frame width at 0.1 Hz) so the loop point stays invisible

sun.state: low on the horizon, just clearing the far ridge, naturally diffused by mist — a real photographed sun, soft-edged, never a painted disc

water.reflections: physically realistic mirror of mountains, sky, sun and trees, carrying tiny natural distortions from extremely subtle water movement — never a perfect flip

mountain_layers.detail: huge irregular ridgeline with natural rock formations, couloirs and snow patches following real accumulation logic; golden rim light on sun-facing slopes
overlapping shoulders with scree fields, patchy snow and thinning vegetation at altitude
low forested shoreline hills with an uneven, natural treeline

lake.shoreline: natural gravel and stone at the camera position, mostly hidden below frame

distant_pines.species: alpine spruce and pine, mixed ages and heights
distant_pines.detail: individually irregular silhouettes — broken branches, uneven tiers, no two alike
distant_pines.motion: very gentle morning-wind sway, max ±0.5° at the tip, per-tree phase offsets

foreground_vegetation.form: sparse alpine grasses and low sedge at the lower frame corners, softly out of focus
foreground_vegetation.motion: occasional slight movement in the breeze — intermittent, never continuous
foreground_vegetation.prominence: peripheral only; must not compete with the microphone

fog_layer.placement: hugging the lake surface between mid_range and near_hills

atmospheric_particles.region: air within the volumetric light and around the microphone

microphone.style: premium real-world large-diaphragm studio condenser, photographed product-true
microphone.finish: matte black metal with fine brushed texture

parts.name: capsule_head
parts.detail: pill-shaped head with a real woven wire grille — visible weave, physically accurate open structure

parts.name: body
parts.detail: cylindrical metal body with vertical brushing and machined tolerances

parts.name: bezel_ring
parts.detail: machined ring joining head and body with a fine chamfer

parts.name: stand
parts.detail: slim rod on a weighted low-profile round base

microphone.imperfections: tiny real-world flaws — hairline micro-scratches, faint edge wear on the base rim, a few microscopic dust specks; nothing pristine or synthetic
microphone.shadows: physically correct contact shadow and soft directional shadow from the low sun
microphone.proportions: physically accurate to a real studio microphone; correct perspective at 50mm from camera height
microphone.focus: extremely sharp — the focus plane is locked to the capsule while the mountains gradually soften with distance

reflection_in_lake.softness: blurred, vertically squashed, broken by ripples

microphone.animation: static — only camera motion, light and depth of field interact with it

voice_waveform.integration: NOT a UI overlay — the microphone appears to emit a faint luminous visualization of detected sound that exists in the scene's air, wrapping around the microphone and interacting with its surfaces

geometry.placement: a slim horizontal band around the microphone at lower-body height, passing in front of the stand and slightly behind it, seen nearly edge-on
geometry.depth_behavior: the portion passing behind the microphone is dimmed and softly occluded
geometry.edge_window: asymmetric taper — both ends fade to zero at slightly different rates, never mirror-symmetric

behavior.description: Gently changes amplitude as if someone is speaking calmly — a natural, irregular speech pattern with swells, hesitations and rests.

amplitude_envelope.model: sum and product of low-frequency sinusoids shaped by a smoothstep gate, with scattered phases so the rhythm never feels metronomic
amplitude_envelope.irregularity: phases and weights chosen so no two swells within the loop have the same shape; never perfectly repetitive, never perfectly symmetrical

behavior.restraint: remains subtle and premium at all times; never dominates the landscape

mic_body_metal.normal_detail: fine brushed micro-scratches, subtle machining marks, microscopic surface waviness
mic_body_metal.imperfection_maps: hairline scratches and faint smudge variation in roughness — real handled metal, not showroom-perfect
mic_body_metal.reflections: subtle physically traced environment reflections — matte, never glossy

mic_grille_mesh.geometry: two crossed layers of actual woven steel wire with real depth and occlusion between layers

mic_stand_metal.detail: matte powder-coat with faint edge wear on the base rim

features: 0.5–2 cm capillary ripple normals producing tiny natural reflection distortions

snow.distribution: natural patches following gullies and shaded faces

rock.detail: stratified granite with erosion patterns, never smooth or geometric

alpine_rock.detail: scree, ledges and sparse high-altitude vegetation breaking up the surface

forested_hillside.detail: dense conifer canopy with irregular gaps and height variation

pine_foliage.backlight_response: warm glow through needle edges facing the sun

alpine_grass.detail: thin irregular blades, rendered soft by the shallow depth of field

volumetric_fog.density: thin, with ragged procedural falloff — natural fog structure, never a uniform plane

dust_mote.visibility: bright only against the volumetric light, invisible in shadow

waveform_emissive.gradient: cyan core blending to blue at the extremities, desaturated slightly by the filmic grade so it sits inside the scene's palette
waveform_emissive.emission_intensity: faint — reads as luminous air, never as a graphic; no neon

light_spill.character: very subtle cyan reflection on the nearby microphone surface, modulated by the speech envelope

key_light.direction: low on the horizon, from screen-right of center
key_light.quality: soft — naturally diffused by atmosphere and mist
produces: warm sunlight on the edges of the microphone
golden highlights on peaks, fog and water

fill_light.produces: cool blue shadows in the mountains and soft ambient fill

volumetric_light.source: sunlight passing naturally through the mountain mist

practical_light.effect: faint cyan spill onto the microphone body and water, modulated by the speech envelope

lighting.global_illumination: physically realistic multi-bounce — sky bounce into shadows, warm ground bounce near sunlit rock

exposure.strategy: protect the sun-core with soft cinematic highlight rolloff while holding shadow detail; no exaggerated glow anywhere

lighting.lens_flare: only when physically appropriate — a restrained veiling glare as the sun grazes the frame edge of the lens; never a stylized flare element
lighting.palette_strategy: natural colors: deep blue shadows, warm golden highlights, everything slightly desaturated toward a filmic neutral

camera.position: at the lake edge, lens at microphone height

lens.type: spherical cinema prime with natural optical character
lens.depth_of_field: large realistic optical falloff — the microphone is extremely sharp and the mountains gradually soften with distance, layer by layer

focus_breathing.model: field of view oscillates ±0.15% sinusoidally at 0.1 Hz
focus_breathing.character: subtle lens breathing, as on a real cinema prime

lens.bokeh: smooth optical discs, slight cat-eye toward frame edges

movement.profile: cosine round trip (1.000 → 1.010 → 1.000) so the loop point stays invisible
movement.feel: expensive, calm and intentional — professional dolly, almost imperceptible

micro_drift.model: per-axis sum of two sinusoids (0.2 Hz and 0.3 Hz) with phase offsets, amplitude ≤ 0.02% of frame width
micro_drift.character: microscopic stabilized drift — a supported camera breathing, never shake, never handheld wobble

animations.character: slow fog movement across the lake surface, barely perceptible
extremely subtle ripples that gently disturb the reflections; sparse glints, warmer inside the sun's light column
gentle distant movement in the morning wind, non-synchronized

animations.model: smooth gusts gated by 0.5 + 0.5*sin(2π * t/10 + φ_blade), peak deflection 1.5°, long still intervals between stirs
animations.character: occasional slight movement, mostly at rest

animations.model: closed orbits — per particle: A_x sin(2π k_x t/10 + φ), A_y sin(2π k_y t/10 + ψ) with integer k
animations.character: tiny motes drifting through the volumetric light

animations.model: env(t) = 0.12 + 0.88 * smoothstep(0.14, 0.62, weighted mix of sin(2π·k·t/10 + φ_k) terms, k ∈ {1,2,3,5,7}, phases scattered)
animations.character: calm speech — irregular swells, hesitations and rests; no two swells alike within the loop
imperceptible warmth breathing shared by the volumetric light

rendering.style: photorealistic — must read as captured footage, never as a render
rendering.pipeline: physically based rendering throughout, spectral where available
engine_hints: unbiased path tracing with full global illumination
physically traced reflections and refraction on water and metal
volumetric integration for fog, light shafts and atmospheric haze
denoiser tuned to preserve micro-detail before grain is re-applied in post
rendering.detail_level: ultra-high — grille weave, brushed-metal micro-scratches, rock strata and needle clusters all resolve at 4K
anti_synthetic_measures: no repeated textures or instanced patterns visible at 4K
no perfectly straight ridgelines or evenly spaced trees
highlight and shadow behavior driven by physical light transport only
rendering.anti_aliasing: supersampling or high-sample temporal AA, no edge crawl

color_pipeline.output: Rec.709 / sRGB display-referred SDR master, HDR-ready grade

rendering.performance_notes: Designed as an app background: low temporal complexity, no flashing, large quiet regions compress efficiently and loop losslessly.

bloom.character: restrained physical halation on true highlights only — sun core, brightest glints, waveform core

lens_effects.veiling_glare: subtle warm glare near the sun, physically motivated only
lens_effects.bokeh_treatment: optical — smooth discs, slight cat-eye at edges, no synthetic shapes

tone_mapping.curve: soft filmic contrast with gentle cinematic highlight rolloff
tone_mapping.black_point: lifted a touch — deep blue shadows retain detail

color_grade.look: premium cinematic: deep blue shadows, warm golden highlights, neutral mids
color_grade.saturation: slightly desaturated filmic look; oversaturation avoided everywhere, including the waveform
color_grade.dynamic_range: high — natural HDR feel within an SDR master
color_grade.consistency: grade is static across the loop — only light animates

film_grain.loop_safe: grain pattern cycles with the 10 s loop

post_processing.sharpening: none beyond capture sharpness — the lens does the work
post_processing.overlays: none — no text, no watermarks, no UI

constraints.aesthetic: calm, peaceful, sophisticated, premium — a luxury commercial frame
constraints.motion_budget: everything moves almost invisibly and naturally slowly; nothing distracts from interface content overlaid on top
constraints.flash_safety: no strobing or rapid luminance changes
constraints.loop_requirement: mathematically seamless and visually invisible at exactly 10.000 s
constraints.overlay_readiness: quiet upper and lower thirds; the microphone is the only strong focal point
